# Tidewater Source Record

- Project: **Tidewater** — an island fishing game for the browser on a custom
  WebGPU / WGSL engine (FFT ocean, breaking surf, swash simulation, physically
  based sky, volumetric clouds, cascaded shadows, temporal upscaling).
- Author: Daniel Greenheck / DRG Software Solutions LLC.
- Upstream: https://github.com/dgreenheck/tidewater — live build
  https://dgreenheck.github.io/tidewater/
- License: **MIT** (`LICENSE` in this directory — preserved verbatim; the
  copyright and permission notice must remain with every copy of the code).
  Third-party assets keep their own licences, recorded in `CREDITS.md`,
  `public/audio/CREDITS.md`, `public/models/debris/CREDITS.md`,
  `public/models/props/CREDITS.md`, `public/models/characters/LICENSE-Rocketbox.md`
  and `public/clouds/LICENSING.md` (all CC0 / MIT / OFL / Apache-2.0; audited
  for BodyArcade CP10 — see the checkpoint report).
- Pinned commit: **`4811ba48d795197de5621985f404e765c0b7c0ef`**
  ("Backwash: no ruled line at the draining sheet's edge", 2026-09-24). At the
  time of import (2026-10-16) this was also the tip of upstream `main`.
- Acquired: `git clone` of upstream, `git checkout 4811ba48…`, then
  `git archive` of that commit extracted here (430 tracked files, no `.git`).
- Role on the `bodyarcade-tidewater-cp10` branch: the **pristine, frozen
  visual baseline** and the **host engine** of `apps/tidewater-dolphin/`.
  - Reference state A (pristine Tidewater) runs from this directory
    unmodified: `npm install && npm run dev` → http://127.0.0.1:5189
  - The integrated BodyArcade app (`../../src/`) imports engine, ocean, sky,
    world and post modules from `./src/` **in place** and never edits them.
    Every behavioural change for the dolphin lives in app-owned adapters under
    `../../src/`; where an orchestration file had to change (App.js, main.js,
    AppUI.js) the app carries its own derived copy, and the derivation is
    recorded in the CP10 report.
- Do not edit anything under this directory. `node_modules/` (created by the
  pristine launch) is ignored by the upstream `.gitignore`.
